body.message:
I would be happy if you could help and do a detailed, data-driven short-term cash flow and return forecast, as well as a long-term financial model. The analysis should include a pessimistic scenario (e.g., lower occupancy rates), along with a full breakdown of both revenue streams and cost structures.
I specifically need a clear breakdown of the following:
– expected average and seasonal occupancy rates
– pricing strategy (dynamic pricing, seasonal adjustments, competitor-based pricing)
– full operating cost structure
– net returns under different scenarios

In addition, I want a precise understanding of the total cost implications for operating in Business Bay if I own an apartment in Regalia (newly built). I also need a clear explanation of the full operational model, including management, operations, commissions, and all associated expenses.

My goal is to obtain a fully transparent, numbers-backed business overview of how this investment would perform in practice.
 we are considering using it for short-term rentals. We would like to understand how viable and profitable this strategy could be.
For this reason, I would need precise and data-backed figures to properly evaluate the potential return and overall feasibility of the investment.
